body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Motorola introduced its new handset 'Motorola Hint QA30' during CES 2009, which comes with several ways for consumers to keep in touch with their social circles. The innovative slider design reveals a full qwerty keypad when open, making messaging and browsing easy and natural.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
